resources.string: Experimental Mali-G615 integration: import the PanVK Linux driver; Steam on this device is not validated
Mali: no imported Linux Vulkan driver. Import the experimental PanVK package under GPU drivers → Advanced → Runtime driver, then select it.
Experimental Mali-G615: import and select PanVK as the Runtime driver. The Display driver uses system Vulkan. Start at 1280×720; keep HDR and frame generation off. Games are not validated.
Software keeps the Mali GPU out of the session entirely: no /dev/mali0, no render node, no probe. It is slow - it exists to check the stack, not to play.
Software on this Mali GPU; nothing changes on an Adreno
CPU only; the GPU node is never handed to the session
Hands /dev/mali0 to the session as a render node; it has restarted this phone before
Mali driver selected: GPU safety is now the experimental Mali setting. Auto and Software keep the GPU out of the session.
